lead: Follow the agents from the phone: what waits for a decision, allow or refuse, send a prompt, read the end of the output of an agent. The phone connects through an ngrok tunnel, and every call needs the pairing key.
pairStep: Scan this QR code with the camera of the phone.
firstVisit: The first time, the phone shows a warning page of ngrok. Tap the button Visit Site. The address stays the same, so you scan the QR code only once.
openTitle: Open the page, already paired, in the web browser of this computer
qrSecret: The QR code contains the pairing key: do not show it, do not share it.
revokeTitle: The devices already paired will have to scan the QR code again
ngrokNotInstalled: The program ngrok is not installed on this computer. Without it, the mobile access is impossible. Install it with the command brew install ngrok. Then create a free account at ngrok.com, and run the command ngrok config add-authtoken followed by your token.
error.ngrokMissing: The program ngrok is not installed on this computer, and Heidrun Code needs it to open the tunnel. Install it with the command brew install ngrok. Then create a free account at ngrok.com, and run the command ngrok config add-authtoken followed by your token. Heidrun Code tries again every few seconds.
error.ngrokCannotStart: Heidrun Code cannot start the program ngrok.
error.ngrokNoAddress: The program ngrok gave no address after 30 seconds. Check the Internet connection of this computer. Heidrun Code tries again in a few seconds.
error.ngrokStopped: The program ngrok stopped. Heidrun Code starts it again in a few seconds.
error.ngrokNotSignedIn: The program ngrok has no account on this computer. Create a free account at ngrok.com, then run the command ngrok config add-authtoken followed by your token. Heidrun Code tries again every 15 seconds.
error.ngrokAddressInUse: Another program ngrok already uses the address of your ngrok account. Close that program, or quit the other copy of Heidrun Code. Heidrun Code tries again in a few seconds.
oldNgrokStopped: The old ngrok is stopped. Heidrun Code opens the tunnel again in a few seconds.
oldNgrokNotFound: Heidrun Code did not start the other ngrok. Close it by hand: it can run in a terminal, or on another computer with the same ngrok account. To stop every ngrok of this computer, run this command in a terminal. Heidrun Code starts its own ngrok again in a few seconds:
terminalTyping: Allow typing in terminals from the phone
error.cannotListen: Heidrun Code cannot listen on the local address. Another program may use the port. Heidrun Code tries again in a few seconds.
